Class WidgetSpec

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.widgets.WidgetSpec
public final class WidgetSpec extends Object
Describes a control's initial values and callbacks without creating a live screen.

Reuse a declaration to open several screens with independent controls. Each screen creates fresh live instances from it. The declaration itself cannot be changed in place, but mutable data captured by callbacks remains shared unless your code separates it.
